claim: When agents follow similar steps in a multi-agent scientific discovery process, the generated hypotheses share overall concepts and methodologies but differ in details.
falsifier: In a multi-agent system for hypothesis generation, vary the degree of similarity in agent steps and measure the overlap in concepts and details of the resulting hypotheses.

conditions: agents are configured with similar procedural steps
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, tasks, and experimental conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Similar steps followed by–generated hypotheses share overall principle
